title.en: Learner Drivers Prohibited Zone on Island Eastern Corridor
title.tc: 東區走廊學習駕駛人士禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374 SUB. LEG. G) Learner Drivers Prohibited Zone on Island Eastern Corridor In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374 sub. leg. G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 18 December 2020, the slip road leading from Shun Tai Road to Island Eastern Corridor (southbound) will be designated as a learner drivers prohibited zone 24 hours daily. Learner drivers, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通（交通管制）規例（第374章，附屬法例G） 東區走廊學習駕駛人士禁區 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第374章，附屬法例G）第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2020年12月18日上午10時起，由順泰道通往東區走廊(南行)的支路將全日24小時劃為學習駕駛人士禁區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，學習駕駛人士一律全日24小時禁止駕駛任何車輛進入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374) Restricted Zones in Ho Wo Street, Tuen Mun In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 a.m. on 27 December 2020, the following road sections will be designated as restricted zones 24 hours daily: (a) the eastern kerbside lane of the section of Ho Wo Street from its junction with Ho Yat Street to a point about 100 metres south of the same junction; (b) the western kerbside lane of the section of Ho Wo Street from a point about 125 metres south of its junction with Ho Yat Street to a point about 105 metres south of the same junction; (c) the eastern kerbside lane of the section of Ho Wo Street from a point about 375 metres south of its junction with Ho Yat Street to a point about 540 metres south of the same junction; (d) the western kerbside lane of the section of Ho Wo Street from a point about 520 metres south of its junction with Ho Yat Street to a point about 395 metres south of the same junction; (e) the western kerbside lane of the section of Ho Wo Street from a point about 655 metres south of its junction with Ho Yat Street to a point about 635 metres south of the same junction; and (f) the eastern kerbside lane of the section of Ho Wo Street from a point about 655 metres south of its junction with Ho Yat Street to a point about 780 metres south of the same junction. title.en: Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods in Tuen Mun
title.tc: 屯門運送危險品車輛的禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374) Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods in Tuen Mun In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 a.m. on 27 December 2020, the following road sections in Tuen Mun will be designated as prohibited zones 24 hours daily for motor vehicles more particularly described below: (a) the slip road leading from Ho Yat Street roundabout to Tuen Mun Chek Lap Kok Tunnel Road southbound; (b) the section of Ho Wo Street between Ho Wo Street and Tuen Mun Chek Lap Kok Tunnel Road northbound; and (c) Tuen Mun Chek Lap Kok Tunnel Road. Drivers of all motor vehicles described below will be prohibited from driving into the above prohibited zones: (a) any vehicles carrying dangerous goods specified in Categories 1, 2 or 5 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A); (b) any vehicles carrying any cylinder (as defined in regulation 61 of the Dangerous Goods (General) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. B)) used or to be used for the storage of compressed gas specified in Category 2 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A), whether or not such cylinder contains any quantity of such gas; and (c) any vehicles constructed or adapted for the conveyance, or any vehicle carrying a container used or to be used for the storage, of goods specified in Category 5 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A), whether or not such vehicle or container contains any quantity of such goods. Notwithstanding the above, the prohibited zones shall not apply to the following motor vehicles:- (a) a vehicle carrying any of the goods specified in Category 2 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A) the quantity of which does not exceed the quantity specified in relation to such goods in the second column of the Table to regulation 74 of the Dangerous Goods (General) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. B); (b) a vehicle carrying any of the goods specified in Category 5 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A) the quantity of which does not exceed the quantity specified in relation to such goods in the seventh or eighth column of the Table to regulation 99 of the Dangerous Goods (General) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. B); (c) a vehicle conveying fuel carried in the fuel tank of that vehicle for the purpose only of its propulsion; (d) (in the case of a vehicle carrying petroleum spirit in its fuel tank for the purpose only of its propulsion) a vehicle conveying petroleum spirit, up to a maximum of 20 litres in securely closed cans, carried on the vehicle for such purpose; (e) a vehicle carrying dangerous goods which is driven for any fire services, ambulance or police purpose; and (f) a vehicle permitted to carry diesel oil in the Tuen Mun-Chek Lap Kok Tunnel for the purpose of replenishing refuelling facilities for franchised bus in accordance with regulation 11(4A) of the Road Tunnels (Government) Regulations (Chapter 368 sub. leg. A), subject to any condition the Commissioner for Transport considers appropriate. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. L AW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374章) 屯門運送危險品車輛的禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2020年12月27日上午8 時起，屯門下列路段全日24小時劃為下述機動車輛禁區： (a) 連接浩逸街迴旋處及屯門赤鱲角隧道公路(南行)的支路； (b) 介乎浩和街與屯門赤鱲角隧道公路(北行)之間的一段浩和街；及 (c) 屯門赤鱲角隧道公路。 下述機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區： (a) 任何運載《危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例A)附表第1、2或5類中指明的危險品的車輛； (b) 任何運載用作或將用作貯存《危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例A)附表第2類中指明的壓縮氣體的任何氣瓶(《危險品(一般)規例》(第295章，附屬法例B)第61條所界定者)的車輛，不論該氣瓶是否載有任何分量的該等氣體；及 (c) 任何在構造上是用以或經改裝以運送《危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例A)附表第5類中指明的貨品的車輛，或任何運送用作或將用作貯存該等貨品的盛器的車輛，不論該車輛或盛器是否載有任何分量的該等貨品。 儘管有以上規定，上述禁區不適用於以下機動車輛： (a) 運載《危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例A)附表第2類中指明的任何貨品的車輛，而該車輛所運載的該等貨品的分量，並不超逾在《危險品(一般)規例》(第295章，附屬法例B)第74條表內第2欄就該等貨品指明的分量； (b) 運載《危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例A)附表第5類中指明的任何貨品的車輛，而該車輛所運載的該等貨品的分量，並不超逾在《危險品(一般)規例》(第295章，附屬法例B)第99條表內第7或8欄就該等貨品指明的分量； (c) 運送僅為驅動該車輛本身而載於其燃料箱內的燃料的車輛； (d) (就僅為驅動該車輛本身在其燃料箱內的燃料的車輛而言)運送符合以下說明的且作該用途的汽油的車輛：不超逾20升並存於密封的罐內的汽油； (e) 運載危險品且駕駛作任何消防服務、救護或警隊用途的車輛；及 (f) 根據《行車隧道(政府)規例》(第368章，附屬法例A)第11(4A)條，獲容許在屯門-赤鱲角隧道內運載柴油以補充專利巴士的加油設施的車輛，而有關許可受運輸署署長認為適當的條件規限。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.tc: 西九龍雅翔道北行天橋至西九龍公路(南行)連接路運送危險品車輛的禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374) Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods on Connection Road joining Elevated Nga Cheung Road Northbound to West Kowloon Highway Southbound, West Kowloon In exercise of the powers vested in me under section 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 29 January 2021, the connection road joining elevated Nga Cheung Road Northbound to West Kowloon Highway Southbound in West Kowloon will be designated as a prohibited zone for following motor vehicles 24 hours daily: (a) any vehicles carrying dangerous goods specified in Categories 1, 2 or 5 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A); (b) any vehicles carrying any cylinders as defined in regulation 61 of the Dangerous Goods (General) Regulations (Cap. 295 sub. leg. B), used or to be used for the storage of any compressed gas specified in Category 2 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Cap. 295 sub. leg. A), whether or not such cylinders contain any quantity of such gas; and (c) any vehicles constructed or adapted for the conveyance, or any vehicles carrying a container used or to be used for the storage of goods specified in Category 5 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Cap. 295 sub. leg. A), whether or not such vehicle or container contains any quantity of such goods. Notwithstanding the above, the prohibited zone shall not apply to the following motor vehicles:- (a) a vehicle carrying any of the goods specified in Category 2 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A) the quantity of which does not exceed the quantity specified in relation to such goods in the second column of the Table to regulation 74 of the Dangerous Goods (General) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. B); (b) a vehicle carrying any of the goods specified in Category 5 of the Schedule to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. A) the quantity of which does not exceed the quantity specified in relation to such goods in the seventh or eighth column of the Table to regulation 99 of the Dangerous Goods (General) Regulations (Chapter 295 sub. leg. B); (c) a vehicle conveying fuel carried in the fuel tank of that vehicle for the purpose only of its propulsion; (d) (in the case of a vehicle carrying petroleum spirit in its fuel tank for the purpose only of its propulsion) a vehicle conveying petroleum spirit, up to a maximum of 20L in securely closed cans, carried on the vehicle for such purpose; and (e) a vehicle carrying dangerous goods which is driven for any fire services, ambulance or police purpose. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374 章 ) 西九 龍雅翔道北行天橋至西九龍公路 ( 南行 ) 連接路運送危險品車輛 的 禁區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374 章 ) 第 14 (1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2021 年 1 月 29 日上午 10 時起， 西九 龍雅翔道北行天橋至西九龍公路 ( 南行 ) 連接路將 全日 24 小時 劃為下述機動車輛禁區： (a) 任何運載《危險品 ( 適用及豁免 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 A) 附表第 1 、 2 或 5 類中指明的危險品的車輛； (b) 任何運載用作或將用作貯存《危險品 ( 適用及豁免 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 A) 附表第 2 類中指明的壓縮氣體的任何氣瓶 ( 《危險品 ( 一般 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 B) 第 61 條所界定者 ) 的車輛，不論該氣瓶是否載有任何分量的該等氣體；及 (c) 任何在構造上是用以或經改裝以運送《危險品 ( 適用及豁免 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 A) 附表第 5 類中指明的貨品的車輛，或任何運送用作或將用作貯存該等貨品的盛器的車輛，不論該車輛或盛器是否載有任何分量的該等貨品。 儘管有以上規定，上述禁區不適用於以下機動車輛： (a) 運載《危險品 ( 適用及豁免 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 A) 附表第 2 類中指明的任何貨品的車輛，而該車輛所運載的該等貨品的分量，並不超逾在《危險品 ( 一般 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 B) 第 74 條表內第 2 欄就該等貨品指明的分量； (b) 運載《危險品 ( 適用及豁免 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 A) 附表第 5 類中指明的任何貨品的車輛，而該車輛所運載的該等貨品的分量，並不超逾在《危險品 ( 一般 ) 規例》 ( 第 295 章，附屬法例 B) 第 99 條表內第 7 或 8 欄就該等貨品指明的分量； (c) 運送僅為驅動該車輛本身而載於其燃料箱內的燃料的車輛； (d) ( 就僅為驅動該車輛本身在其燃料箱內的燃料的車輛而言 ) 運送符合以下說明的且作該用途的汽油的車輛：不超逾 20 升並存於密封的罐內的汽油； 及 (e) 運載危險品且駕駛作任何消防服務、救護或警隊用途的車輛。 有關地點 將 設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長 羅淑佩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 9 Metres in Length on Lei Yue Mun Path, Kwun Tong In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 6.01 pm on 31 October 2021 to 6.00 pm on 31 December 2021, Lei Yue Mun Path will continue to be temporarily designated a prohibited zone for all motor vehicles exceeding 9 metres in length 24 hours daily (except for emergency vehicles). Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 9 metres in length into the prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone has been indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374章) 延長鯉魚門徑長度超逾9米車輛臨時禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2021 年 10 月 31 日下午 6 時 1 分起，至 2021 年 12 月 31 日下午6時止，鯉魚門徑將全日24小時繼續暫劃為長度超逾9米車輛禁區(緊急服務車輛除外)。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾9米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點已設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.en: Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 8 Metres in Length in Reclamation Street, Yau Ma Tei

title.en: Prohibited Zones in Ma Wan, Tsuen Wan
title.tc: 荃灣馬灣禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374) Prohibited Zones in Ma Wan, Tsuen Wan In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 9.00 am on 18 December 2021, all roads in Ma Wan will be designated prohibited zones 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the prohibited zones 24 hours daily except: goods vehicles from 10.00 am to 4.00 pm daily; urban taxis for access to/from Ma Wan Road, the roundabout between Ma Wan Road and Pak Lam Road, Pak Lam Road south of Fong Yuen Road, Fong Yuen Road east of Ma Wan Rural Committee Road and Ma Wan Rural Committee Road 24 hours daily; and to/from Pak Yan Road and the section of Pak Lai Road between Pak Lam Road and Pak Yan Road from 00 am to 9.00 pm daily; buses from 00 am to 9.00 pm daily for access to/from Ma Wan Road, the roundabout between Ma Wan Road and Pak Lam Road, Pak Lam Road south of Fong Yuen Road, Fong Yuen Road, Pak Yan Road and the section of Pak Lai Road between Pak Lam Road and Pak Yan Road; and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zones in Ma Wan, Tsuen Wan as gazetted in G.N. 4295 of 2014 will be rescinded. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例（第374章） 荃灣 馬灣禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2021年12月18日上午9時起，馬灣所有道路全日24小時劃為禁區。 除： 貨車（只限每日上午 10 時至下午 4 時）； 市區的士全日 24 小時往來馬灣路、馬灣路與珀林路之間的迴旋處、芳園路以南的一段珀林路、馬灣鄉事會路以東的一段芳園路和馬灣鄉事會路，及每日上午9時至晚上9時往來珀欣路和介乎珀林路與珀欣路之間的一段珀麗路； 巴士每日上午9時至晚上9時往來馬灣路、馬灣路與珀林路之間的迴旋處、芳園路以南的一段珀林路、芳園路、珀欣路和介乎珀林路與珀欣路之間的一段珀麗路；及 經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外。 機動車輛司機全日24小時一律禁止駕駛車輛進入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，據2014年第4295號政府公告所公布，現時在荃灣馬灣實施的禁區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.en: Restricted Zones on Siu Lun Street in Tuen Mun
title.tc: 屯門兆麟街限制區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374) Restricted Zones on Siu Lun Street in Tuen Mun In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 a.m. on 24 December 2021 (Friday), the following road sections in Tuen Mun will be designated as restricted zones 24 hours daily: the northern kerbside lane of Siu Lun Street eastbound from a point about 95 metres east of its junction with Tuen Mun Heung Sze Wui Road to a point about 215 metres east of the same junction; and the southern kerbside lane of Siu Lun Street westbound from a point about 215 metres east of its junction with Tuen Mun Heung Sze Wui Road to a point about 110 metres east of the same junction. Within the restricted zones, drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: picking up or setting down passengers; or loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs and road markings. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例（第374章） 屯門兆麟街限制區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374章)第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2021年12月24日(星期五)上午10時起，下列路段將全日24小時劃為限制區： 兆麟街( 東行 ) 由其與屯門鄉事會 路交界以東約95米處起，至同一交界以東約215米處止的北面路旁行車線；及 兆麟街( 西行 )由其與屯門鄉事會路交界以東約215米處起，至同一交界以東約110米處止的南面路旁行車線。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： 上落乘客；或 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌及道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 9 Metres in Length on Lei Yue Mun Path, Kwun Tong
title.tc: 鯉魚門徑長度超逾9米車輛臨時禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 9 Metres in Length on Lei Yue Mun Path, Kwun Tong In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 am on 7 March 2022 to 5.00 pm on 31 August 2022, Lei Yue Mun Path will be temporarily designated a prohibited zone for all motor vehicles exceeding 9 metres in length from 8.00 am to 5.00 pm daily. title.en: Prohibited Zones for Buses and Taxis at Discovery Bay, Lantau Island
title.tc: 大嶼山愉景灣巴士及的士禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374) Prohibited Zones for Buses and Taxis at Discovery Bay, Lantau Island In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.00 a.m. on 2 April 2022 to 11.59 p.m. on 29 April 2022, the following roads in Discovery Bay, Lantau Island will be designated as prohibited zones for buses and taxis 24 hours daily:— (1) the section of Siena Avenue between its junction with Discovery Bay Road and the roundabout 150m south of the Discovery Bay Community Hall; (2) Siena One Drive; (3) Discovery Bay Road; (4) Bayside Drive; (5) Amalfi Drive; (6) Parkland Drive; (7) Chianti Drive; (8) Seabee Lane; (9) Headland Drive; (10) Seahorse Lane; (11) Seabird Lane; " (12) Plaza Lane; (13) Parkridge Crescent; (14) Parkvale Drive; (15) Middle Lane; (16) Discovery Valley Road; (17) Vista Avenue; (18) Serene Avenue; (19) Costa Avenue; (20) Marina Drive; (21) Capevale Drive; (22) Caperidge Drive; (23) Capeland Drive (24) Bijou Drive; and (25) all unnamed access roads leading to the above-mentioned roads from (1) to (24). All buses and taxis (except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport) will be prohibited from entering the above prohibited zones 24 hours daily. At the same time, the existing prohibited zone for taxis and buses designated in Discovery Bay, Lantau Island as gazetted under G.N. 6095 on 26 October 2014 will be temporarily rescinded. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374 章 ) 大嶼山愉景灣巴士 及的士 禁區 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》(第374章)第14(1)(a)條所予的權 力，下令由2022年4月2日凌晨12時至2022年4月29日晚上11時59分，大嶼山愉景灣下列道路將會全日24小時劃為巴士及的士禁區︰ (1) 海澄湖畔路由其與愉景灣道交界處起至其與愉景灣社區會堂以南150米的迴旋處止的路段； (2) 海澄徑一段； (3) 愉景灣道； (4) 堤畔徑； (5) 津堤徑； (6) 明蔚徑； (7) 尚堤徑； (8) 海蜂徑； (9) 朝暉徑； (10) 海馬徑； (11) 海燕徑； (12) 廣場徑； (13) 明翠徑； (14) 寶峰徑； (15) 畔山徑； (16) 愉景山道； (17) 海寧徑； (18) 海藍徑； (19) 海堤徑； (20) 遊艇徑； (21) 蘅暉徑； (22) 蘅欣徑； (23) 蘅安徑； (24) 壁如徑；及 (25) 與上述 (1) 至 (24) 道路連接的所有未命名通路。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，巴士及的士一律全日24小時禁止進入上述禁區。 同時，據2014年10月26日第6095號政府公告所公布，現時於大嶼山愉景灣實施的的士及巴士禁區將予以暫時撤銷。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.tc: 港珠澳大橋香港口岸公共運輸交匯處上客區禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374) Prohibited Zone in Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port Public Transport Interchange Pick-Up Area In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 12 midnight on 23 July 2022, the following sections of roads at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port Public Transport Interchange Pick-up Area will be designated as prohibited zones 24 hours daily: - Drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the third cul-de-sac fom the west end of this public transport interchange; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses, public light buses (scheduled services) and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the fourth cul-de-sac fom the west end of this public transport interchange; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the fifth cul-de-sac fom the west end of this public transport interchange; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except New Territories Taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the sixth cul-de-sac fom the west end of this public transport interchange; and Drivers of all motor vehicles, except Urban Taxis and Lantau Taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the eastmost cul-de-sac of this public transport interchange. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs on site. At the same time, the prohibited zones on the above road sections as gazetted on 19 October 2018 under G.N.8035 will be rescinded. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374章) 港珠澳大橋香港口岸公共運輸交匯處上客區 禁區 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》(第374章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2022年7月23日凌晨12時起，位於港珠澳大橋香港口岸公共運輸交匯處上客區的下列路段全日24小時劃為禁區 ﹕ 除專利巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第三條盡頭路； 除專利巴士、公共小巴(專線服務)及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第四條盡頭路； 除巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第五條盡頭路； 除新界的士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第六條盡頭路；及 除巿區的士及大嶼山的士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入此公共運輸交匯處最東面的盡頭路。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，據2018年10月19日第8035號政府公告所公布於上述路段實施的禁區範圍將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.en: Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods in Kwun Tong and Tseung Kwan O
title.tc: 觀塘及將軍澳運送危險品車輛的禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374G) Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods in Kwun Tong and Tseung Kwan O In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 a.m. on 11 December 2022, the following road sections in Kwun Tong and Tseung Kwan O will be designated as prohibited zones 24 hours daily for motor vehicles described below: (a) Lam Tin Interchange; (b) the section of Tseung Lam Highway westbound from a point about 550 metres east of the Tseung Kwan O entrance of Tseung Kwan O – Lam Tin Tunnel; and (c) the section of Tseung Lam Highway southbound from a point about 875 metres south of its junction with Po Yap Road to the slip road leading to Tseung Kwan O – Lam Tin Tunnel. Drivers of all motor vehicles described below will be prohibited from driving into the above prohibited zones: (1) a vehicle carrying any dangerous goods specified in Classes 1, 2, 3 or 3A of the Schedule 1 and 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); (2) without limiting paragraph (5), a vehicle carrying a pressure receptacle used or to be used for the storage of Class 2 dangerous goods, whether or not the pressure receptacle contains any quantity of Class 2 dangerous goods; (3) without limiting paragraph (6), a vehicle constructed or adapted for the conveyance of Class 3 dangerous goods, or a vehicle carrying a container used or to be used for the storage of Class 3 dangerous goods, whether or not the vehicle or container contains any quantity of Class 3 dangerous goods; and (4) without limiting paragraph (7), a vehicle constructed or adapted for the conveyance of Class 3A dangerous goods, or a vehicle carrying a container used or to be used for the storage of Class 3A dangerous goods, whether or not the vehicle or container contains any quantity of Class 3A dangerous goods. Notwithstanding the above, the above prohibited zones shall not apply to the following motor vehicles: (5) a vehicle carrying any Class 2 dangerous goods, unless – (i) there is a quantity specified in relation to the Class 2 dangerous goods in column 5 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); and (ii) the Class 2 dangerous goods carried by the vehicle do not exceed that quantity; (6) a vehicle carrying any Class 3 dangerous goods, unless – (i) there is a quantity specified in relation to the Class 3 dangerous goods in column 5 of the table in Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); and (ii) the Class 3 dangerous goods carried by the vehicle do not exceed that quantity; (7) a vehicle carrying any Class 3A dangerous goods, unless – (i) there is a quantity specified in relation to the Class 3A dangerous goods in column 5 of the table in Part 4 of Schedule 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); and (ii) the Class 3A dangerous goods carried by the vehicle do not exceed that quantity; (8) a vehicle conveying fuel which is being carried in its fuel tank for the purpose only of the propulsion of the vehicle; and (9) in the case of a vehicle carrying in its fuel tank petroleum spirit for the purpose only of its propulsion, a vehicle conveying petroleum spirit, up to a maximum of 20 litres in securely closed cans, which is being carried on the vehicle for such purpose. (10) a vehicle carrying dangerous goods which is driven for any fire services, ambulance or police purpose. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 觀塘及將軍澳運送危險品車輛的禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2022年12月11日上午8 時起，觀塘及將軍澳下列路段全日24小時劃為下述機動車輛禁區： (a) 藍田交匯處； (b) 將藍公路西行由其與將軍澳 – 藍田隧道將軍澳入口處以東約550米處起的路段；及 (c) 將藍公路南行由其與寶邑路交界以南約875米處起通往將軍澳 – 藍田隧道的支路。 下述機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區： (1) 運載任何《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表1及2第1、2、3或3A類中指明的危險品的車輛； (2) 在不局限第(5)款的原則下，運載用作或將用作貯存第2 類危險品的壓力氣體容器的車輛，不論該壓力氣體容器是否盛載任何數量的第2 類危險品； (3) 在不局限第(6)款的原則下，經構造或改裝以運載第3類危險品的車輛，或運載用作或將用作貯存第3類危險品的盛器的車輛，不論該車輛或盛器是否盛載任何數量的第3 類危險品；及 (4) 在不局限第(7)款的原則下，經構造或改裝以運載第3A類危險品的車輛，或運載用作或將用作貯存第3A類危險品的盛器的車輛，不論該車輛或盛器是否盛載任何數量的第3A 類危險品。 儘管有以上規定，上述禁區不適用於以下機動車輛： (5) 運載任何第2類危險品的車輛，並符合以下情況─ (i) 《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表2第2部中列表的第5欄對該等第2類危險品的數量有所指明；及 (ii) 該車輛所運載的該等第2類危險品不超逾該數量； (6) 運載任何第3類危險品的車輛，並符合以下情況─ (i) 《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表2第2或3部中列表的第5欄對該等第3類危險品的數量有所指明；及 (ii) 該車輛所運載的該等第3類危險品不超逾該數量； (7) 運載任何第3A類危險品的車輛，並符合以下情況─ (i) 《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表2第4部中列表的第5欄對該等第3A類危險品的數量有所指明；及 (ii) 該車輛所運載的該等第3A類危險品不超逾該數量； (8) 運載僅為驅動該車輛本身而載於其燃料箱內的燃料的車輛； (9) (就僅為驅動該車輛本身而在其燃料箱內載有汽油的車輛而言)運載該車輛上所載作以上用途的汽油的車輛，但該等汽油不得超過20 升，並須存於密封的罐內; 及 (10) 運載危險品且駕駛作任何消防服務、救護或警隊用途的車輛。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Prohibited Zone on Clear Water Bay Road, Kwun Tong In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 a.m. on 16 January 2023, the section of service road of Clear Water Bay Road westbound near Tsuen Shek House, Ping Shek Estate will be designated as prohibited zone 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except public light buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs and road markings. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通( 交通管制) 規例( 第374G 章) 觀塘 清水灣道禁 區 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第374G章）第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2023年1月16日上午10時起，清水灣道(西行)近坪石邨鑽石樓的一段輔助道路將全日24小時劃為禁區。 除公共小巴及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌及道路標記，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.en: Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods in Kwun Tong and Eastern District
title.tc: 觀塘及東區運送危險品車輛的禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods in Kwun Tong and Eastern District In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 10 a.m. on 16 January 2023, the following road sections in Kwun Tong and Eastern District will be designated as prohibited zones 24 hours daily for motor vehicles described below: (a) The section of Eastern Harbour Crossing southbound from a point about 380 metres south of its junction with Lei Yue Mun Road eastbound; (b) The section of Eastern Harbour Crossing southbound from its junction with Lei Yue Mun Road westbound; (c) The slip road leading from Island Eastern Corridor eastbound to Eastern Harbour Crossing northbound; (d) The slip road leading from Island Eastern Corridor westbound to Eastern Harbour Crossing northbound; and (e) Eastern Harbour Crossing. Drivers of all motor vehicles described below will be prohibited from driving into the above prohibited zones: – (1) a vehicle carrying any dangerous goods specified in Classes 1, 2, 3 or 3A of the Schedule 1 and 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); (2) without limiting paragraph (5), a vehicle carrying a pressure receptacle used or to be used for the storage of Class 2 dangerous goods, whether or not the pressure receptacle contains any quantity of Class 2 dangerous goods; (3) without limiting paragraph (6), a vehicle constructed or adapted for the conveyance of Class 3 dangerous goods, or a vehicle carrying a container used or to be used for the storage of Class 3 dangerous goods, whether or not the vehicle or container contains any quantity of Class 3 dangerous goods; and (4) without limiting paragraph (7), a vehicle constructed or adapted for the conveyance of Class 3A dangerous goods, or a vehicle carrying a container used or to be used for the storage of Class 3A dangerous goods, whether or not the vehicle or container contains any quantity of Class 3A dangerous goods. Notwithstanding the above, the above prohibited zones shall not apply to the following motor vehicles: – (5) a vehicle carrying any Class 2 dangerous goods, and – (i) there is a quantity specified in relation to the Class 2 dangerous goods in column 5 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); and (ii) the Class 2 dangerous goods carried by the vehicle do not exceed that quantity; (6) a vehicle carrying any Class 3 dangerous goods, and – (i) there is a quantity specified in relation to the Class 3 dangerous goods in column 5 of the table in Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); and (ii) the Class 3 dangerous goods carried by the vehicle do not exceed that quantity; (7) a vehicle carrying any Class 3A dangerous goods, unless – (i) there is a quantity specified in relation to the Class 3A dangerous goods in column 5 of the table in Part 4 of Schedule 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations 2012 (Chapter 295 sub. leg. E); and (ii) the Class 3A dangerous goods carried by the vehicle do not exceed that quantity; (8) a vehicle conveying fuel which is being carried in its fuel tank for the purpose only of the propulsion of the vehicle; (9) in the case of a vehicle carrying in its fuel tank petroleum spirit for the purpose only of its propulsion, a vehicle conveying petroleum spirit, up to a maximum of 20 litres in securely closed cans, which is being carried on the vehicle for such purpose; and (10) a vehicle carrying dangerous goods which is driven for any fire services, ambulance or police purpose. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zones for vehicles carrying dangerous goods on the above road sections will be rescinded. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 觀塘及東區運送危險品車輛的禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2023年1月16日上午10 時起，觀塘及東區下列路段全日24小時劃為下述機動車輛禁區： (a) 東區海底隧道南行由其與鯉魚門道東行交界以南約380米處起的路段； (b) 東區海底隧道南行由其與鯉魚門道西行交界處起的路段； (c) 由東區走廊東行通往東區海底隧道北行的支路； (d) 由東區走廊西行通往東區海底隧道北行的支路；及 (e) 東區海底隧道。 下述機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區： (1) 運載任何《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表1及2第1、2、3或3A類中指明的危險品的車輛； (2) 在不局限第(5)款的原則下，運載用作或將用作貯存第2 類危險品的壓力氣體容器的車輛，不論該壓力氣體容器是否盛載任何數量的第2 類危險品； (3) 在不局限第(6)款的原則下，經構造或改裝以運載第3類危險品的車輛，或運載用作或將用作貯存第3類危險品的盛器的車輛，不論該車輛或盛器是否盛載任何數量的第3 類危險品；及 (4) 在不局限第(7)款的原則下，經構造或改裝以運載第3A類危險品的車輛，或運載用作或將用作貯存第3A類危險品的盛器的車輛，不論該車輛或盛器是否盛載任何數量的第3A 類危險品。 儘管有以上規定，上述禁區不適用於以下機動車輛： (5) 運載任何第2類危險品並符合以下情況的車輛： (i) 《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表2第2部中列表的第5欄對該等第2類危險品的數量有所指明；及 (ii) 該車輛所運載的該等第2類危險品不超逾該數量； (6) 運載任何第3類危險品的車輛，並符合以下情況： (i) 《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表2第2或3部中列表的第5欄對該等第3類危險品的數量有所指明；及 (ii) 該車輛所運載的該等第3類危險品不超逾該數量； (7) 運載任何第3A類危險品的車輛，並符合以下情況： (i) 《2012年危險品(適用及豁免)規例》(第295章，附屬法例E)附表2第4部中列表的第5欄對該等第3A類危險品的數量有所指明；及 (ii) 該車輛所運載的該等第3A類危險品不超逾該數量； (8) 運載僅為驅動該車輛本身而載於其燃料箱內的燃料的車輛； (9) (就僅為驅動該車輛本身而在其燃料箱內載有汽油的車輛而言)運載該車輛上所載作以上用途的汽油的車輛，但該等汽油不得超過20 升，並須存於密封的罐內; 及 (10) 運載危險品且駕駛作任何消防服務、救護或警隊用途的車輛。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的運送危險品車輛的禁區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長羅淑佩

title.en: Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 12 Metres in Length in Kansu Street, Yau Ma Tei
title.tc: 延長油麻地甘肅街長度超逾12米車輛臨時禁區的實施期限

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 12 Metres in Length in Kansu Street, Yau Ma Tei In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.00 midnight to 6.00 am daily on 1-4, 7-11, 14-18, 21-25, 28 February 2023, 1-4, 7-11, 14-18, 21-25, 28-31 March 2023 and 1, 4, 12-15, 18-22, 25-29 April 2023, the section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street will continue to be temporarily designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all vehicles, except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Sui-chun, Macella Commissioner for Transport (Acting)

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374) Temporary Prohibited Zones in Pak Shek Kok and Ma Liu Shui In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 31 March 2023 to 10.00 am on 30 March 2024, the following sections of cycle track as shown in the Schedule will be temporarily designated as prohibited zones for all vehicles exceeding 0.9 metres in width and motorcycles 24 hours daily: The section of cycle track near Mayfair by the Sea and along Fo Chun Road; The section of cycle track along Pak Shek Kok Promenade and Science Park Road; and The section of cycle track along Sui Cheung Street and Chak Cheung Street. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles exceeding 0.9 metres in width and motorcycles into the above prohibited zones. The exact boundary of the prohibited zones is delineated by hatching on the drawing shown in the Schedule. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LAW Shuk-pui, Rosanna Commissioner for Transport

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 8 Metres in Length on Shatin Pass Road, Wong Tai Sin In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations (Chapter 374), I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 30 June 2023 to 6.00 pm on 30 August 2023, the section of Shatin Pass Road between Fung Tak Road and Lung Cheung Road will continue to be temporarily designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except public light buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. Appropriate traffic signs have been erected on site to indicate the extent of the prohibited zone. LEE Sui-chun, Macella Commissioner for Transport (Acting)
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374章) 延長黃大仙沙田㘭道長度超逾8米車輛臨時禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》(第374章) 第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2023年6月30日上午10時起，至2023年8月30日下午 6 時止，沙田㘭道介乎鳳德道與龍翔道之間的路段，全日24小時繼續暫劃為長度超逾8米車輛的禁區。 除公共小巴及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾8米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點已設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 署理運輸署署長李萃珍

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 9 Metres in Length on Lei Yue Mun Path, Kwun Tong

title.tc: 臨時撤銷北角英皇道禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374 SUB. LEG. G) Temporary Rescission of Prohibited Zones on King's Road, North Point In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374 sub. leg. G, I hereby direct that with effect from 11.00 pm on 19 August 2023 to 8.00 am on 20 August 2023, the following prohibited zones on King's Road will be temporarily rescinded:- (a) the existing prohibited zone at King's Road eastbound from its junction with Ngan Mok Street to its junction with Fortress Hill Road; and (b) the existing prohibited zone at King's Road eastbound from its junction with North Point Road to its junction with Tin Chiu Street. title.en: Extension of Temporary Restricted Zone in Fuk Yan Street, Yuen Long
title.tc: 延續元朗褔欣街臨時限制區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Restricted Zone in Fuk Yan Street, Yuen Long In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 a.m. on 25 August 2023 to 6.00 p.m. on 10 October 2023, the section of Fuk Yan Street from a point of its junction with Fuk Hi Street to a point about 120 meters south of the same junction will continue to be temporarily designated as restricted zone 24 hours daily. Within the restricted zones, drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: picking up or setting down passengers; or loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zones will be indicated by appropriate road markings. LEE Sui-chun, Macella Acting Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374G 章 ) 延續 元朗褔欣街臨時限制區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章) 第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2023年8月25日上午10時起至2023年10月10日晚上6時止，褔欣街由其與褔喜街交界處起，至同一交界以南約120米處止的路段將繼續暫劃為全日24小時限制區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： 上落乘客；或 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 署理運輸署署長李萃珍

title.en: Prohibited Zone for Access Road to Lantau Link Bus-Bus Interchange
title.tc: 青嶼幹線巴士轉乘站通路禁區

content.en: Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations (Chapter 374G) Prohibited Zone for Access Road to Lantau Link Bus-Bus Interchange In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 a.m. on 8 September 2023, the following road sectons will be designated as prohibited zone 24 hours daily: The access road leading from Lantau Link (Airport bound) to Lantau Link Bus-bus Interchange (Airport bound); and The access road leading from North Lantau Highway (Kowloon bound) to Lantau Link Bus-bus Interchange (Kowloon bound). Drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses, for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zone on the above road sections will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport

title.tc: 元朗臨時限制區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374) Temporary Restricted Zones in Yuen Long In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 6.00 p.m. on 22 September 2023 to 6.00 p.m. on 23 October 2023, the following road sections in Yuen Long will be temporarily designated as restricted zones 24 hours daily: the section of Ping Shun Street from its junction with the unnamed access road connecting Ping Shun Street and Ma Wang Road to a point about 30 metres south of the same junction; the section of the unnamed access road connecting Ping Shun Street and Ma Wang Road from its junction with Ping Shun Street to a point about 60 metres west of the same junction; the eastern kerbside lane of the unnamed access road connecting Ping Shun Street and Ma Wang Road from a point about 15 metres south of its junction with Ma Wang Road to a point about 40 metres south of the same junction; Within the restricted zones, drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: picking up or setting down passengers; or loading or unloading goods. content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374 章 ) 元朗臨時限制區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章) 第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2023年9月22日晚上6時至10月23日晚上6時，下列路段將全日24小時暫劃為限制區﹕ 屏信街由其與連接屏信街與媽橫路的未命名通路的交界處起，至同一交界以南約30米處止的路段; 連接屏信街與媽橫路的未命通路由其與屏信街的交界處起至同一交界以西約60米處止的路段； 連接屏信街與媽橫路的未命通路由其與媽橫路的交界以南約15米處起至同一交界以南約40米處止的的東面路旁行車線； 除專利巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在臨時限制區內： 上落乘客；或 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌及道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的限制區，將繼續暫予以撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374) Temporary Rescission of Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 5.5 Tonnes in Gross Weight at Lok Wo Sha Lane, Ma On Shan In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.45 midnight to 5.45 am on 12 December 2023, the prohibited zone for all motor vehicles exceeding 5.5 tonnes in gross weight at Lok Wo Sha Lane eastbound will be temporarily rescinded. title.en: Extension of Temporary Rescission of Prohibited Zone in Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Rescission of Prohibited Zone in Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 0.00 am on 17 December 2023 to 11.59 pm on 31 January 2024, the existing prohibited zone for all motor vehicles (except public light bus) designated on the third easternmost service road in Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange will continue to be temporarily rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374G 章 ) 延長 臨時 撤銷觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處 禁 區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第 374G 章）第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2023 年 12 月 17 日凌晨零時零分起，至 2024 年 1 月 31 日晚上 11 時 59 分止，現時在觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處東面起第三條輔助道路劃設的所有機動車輛 ( 公共小巴除外)禁區，將繼續暫予撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone in Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange
title.tc: 延長觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處臨時禁區的實施期限

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone in Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.00 midnight on 17 December 2023 to 11.59 pm on 31 January 2024, Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange will continue to be temporarily designated as a prohibited zone 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles except franchise buses, public light buses (scheduled services) and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 延 長觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處 臨時禁 區 的實 施 期 限 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第374G章）第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2023年12月17日午夜12時起至2024年1月31日晚上11時59分止，觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處將繼續全日24小時暫劃為禁區。 除專利巴士、專線小巴及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Exceeding 8 Metres and 12 Metres in Length in Yau Ma Tei
title.tc: 油麻地長度超逾8米及12米車輛臨時禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Exceeding 8 Metres and 12 Metres in Length in Yau Ma Tei In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 1 January 2024 to 29 February 2024, the following road sections will be temporarily designated as prohibited zones for vehicles exceeding 8 metres and 12 metres in length 24 hours daily:- (i) The section of Battery Street between Reclamation Street and Kansu Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length 24 hours daily; and (ii) The section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all vehicles, except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 油麻地長度超逾8米及12米車輛臨時禁區 本人現行使《 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2024 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年2月 29 日，以下路段將全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 8 米及 12 米車輛臨時禁區 :- (i) 介乎新填地街及甘肅街之間的炮台街將全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 8 米車輛禁區 ; 及 (ii) 介乎上海街及炮台街之間的甘肅街將全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 12 米車輛禁區。 除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有車輛的司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) PROHIBITED ZONE ON KONG SHAM WESTERN HIGHWAY In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10 am on 23 August 2024, the section of an unnamed road on Kong Sham Western Highway near lamppost BD3234, from its junction with Kong Sham Western Highway to a point about 400 metres west of the same junction, will be designated as prohibited zone 24 hours daily. title.tc: 延長觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處臨時禁區的實施期限

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone in Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 0.00 am on 1 October 2024 to 11.59 pm on 28 December 2024, Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange will continue to be temporarily designated as a prohibited zone 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles except franchise buses, public light buses (scheduled services) and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 延長觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處臨時禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第374G章）第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2024年10月1日凌晨零時零分起至2024年12月28日晚上11時59分止，觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處將繼續全日24小時暫劃為禁區。 除專利巴士、專線小巴及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Temporary Restricted Zone on Wang Chui Road, Kowloon Bay
title.tc: 九龍灣宏照道臨時限制區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Restricted Zone on Wang Chui Road, Kowloon Bay In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 am on 7 October 2024 to 6.00 pm on 30 January 2025, the eastern kerbside lane of Wang Chui Road from a point about 125 metres north of its junction with Kai Yip Road to a point of about 215 metres north of the same junction will be temporarily designated as restricted zone 24 hours daily. Within the restricted zone, drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: picking up or setting down passengers; or loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs and road markings. At the same time, the existing restricted zone on the above road section will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 九龍灣宏照道臨時限制區 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第374G章）第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2024年10月7日上午8時起至2025年1月30日下午6時止，宏照道由其與啟業道交界處以北約 125 米處起，至同一交界處以北約215米處止的東面路旁行車線，全日24小時暫劃為限制區。 除專利巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： 上落乘客；或 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌及道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的限制區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Rescission of Prohibited Zone in Western Harbour Crossing Toll Plaza, Tsim Sha Tsui In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 6.00 am on 7 December 2024 to 6.00 am on 12 January 2025, the existing prohibited zone designated on the outer bus bay in Western Harbour Crossing (Hong Kong bound) T oll Plaza will be temporarily rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 條 例( 第374G 章) 臨時 撤銷 西區海底隧道 收費廣 場 禁區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2024 年12月7日上午 6 時起，至2025年 1 月 12 日上午 6 時止，現時位於西區海底隧道(往香港方向)收費廣場外圍停車灣劃設的禁區，將暫予以撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 10 Metres in Length on Kam Shing Road, Kowloon Tong
title.tc: 九龍塘金城道長度超逾10米車輛臨時禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 10 Metres in Length on Kam Shing Road, Kowloon Tong In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 6 December 2024 to 9.00 am on 28 January 2025, the section of Kam Shing Road between Kam Shing Road house number 1 and Hong Kong Baptist Hospital Block E will be temporarily designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 10 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 10 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 7 metres in length temporarily designated 24 hours daily on the above road section will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 九龍塘 金城道長度超逾10 米車輛臨時禁區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2024 年 12 月 6 日上午 10 時起至 2025 年 1 月 28 日上午 9 時止，金城道介乎金城道門牌 1 號及香港浸信會醫院 E 座之間的路段，全日 24 小時暫劃為長度超逾 10 米車輛禁區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾 10 米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段全日24小時實施的長度超逾7米車輛臨時禁區，將予撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 何文田 嘉道理道長度超逾5 米車輛臨時禁區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2024 年 12 月 14 日上午 8 時起至 2025 年 1 月 25 日下午 6 時止，嘉道理道介乎嘉道理道門牌 73A 號及 81A 號之間的路段，將全日 24 小時暫劃為長度超逾 5 米車輛禁區。 除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾 5 米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Corrigendum
title.tc: 勘誤

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Corrigendum With reference to the Government Notice No. 5758 in Gazette No. 39 of Vol. 28 published on 27 September 2024, it is hereby notified that "Drivers of all vehicles, except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the above prohibited zone" should be amended as "Except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, drivers of all vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length will be prohibited from driving vehicles into above prohibited zone of the section of Reclamation Street between Battery Street and Kansu Street; and drivers of all vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length will be prohibited from driving vehicles into above prohibited zone of the section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street." LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374G 章 ) 勘誤 關於在2024 年 09 月 27 日 星期五 第 28 卷第 39 期憲報第5758號公告中文版，現公布公告所載「除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區」應更正為「除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有長度超逾8米車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入介乎炮台街及甘肅街之間的新填地街的禁區; 及所有長度超逾12米車輛的司機一律禁止將車輛駛入介乎上海街及炮台街之間的甘肅街的禁區。」 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 12 Metres in Length on Hoi Fan Road, Tai Kok Tsui
title.tc: 延長大角咀海帆道長度超逾12米車輛臨時禁區的實施期限

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 12 Metres in Length on Hoi Fan Road, Tai Kok Tsui In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulation, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 6.00 p.m. on 27 December 2024 to 6.00 p.m. on 26 June 2025, the road section of Hoi Fan Road between cul-de-sac of Hoi Fan Road and Hoi Fai Road will continue to be temporarily designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length 24 hours daily (except for access). Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those for access or those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length into the above temporary prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone have been indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 延長大角咀海帆道長度超逾12米車輛臨時禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2024年12月27日下午6時起至2025年6月26日下午6時止，介乎海帆道盡頭路與海輝道之間的一段海帆道將全日24小時繼續暫劃為長度超逾12米的車輛禁區（前往此區者不在此限）。 除前往此區者或經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有機動車輛司機將一律禁止駕駛長度超逾12米的車輛進入上述臨時禁區。 有關地點已設置適當道路標記，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.tc: 道路交通( 交通管制) 規例( 第374G 章) 延長 油麻地 友翔道 長度超 逾8米車輛 臨時 禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年 1 月 1 日凌晨零時起，至 2025 年 3 月 31 日晚上 11 時 59 分止，友翔道將繼續全日 24 小時暫劃為長度超逾 8 米車輛禁區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾8米車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點已設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Exceeding 8 Metres and 12 Metres in Length in Yau Ma Tei
title.tc: 延長油麻地長度超逾8米及12米車輛臨時禁區的實施期限

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Exceeding 8 Metres and 12 Metres in Length in Yau Ma Tei In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 1 January 2025 to 31 March 2025, the following road sections will continue to be temporarily designated as prohibited zones for vehicles exceeding 8 metres and 12 metres in length 24 hours daily:- (i) The section of Reclamation Street between Battery Street and Kansu Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length 24 hours daily; and (ii) The section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all vehicles, except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length into the section of Reclamation Street between Battery Street and Kansu Street; and vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length into the section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street. The extent of the prohibited zone have been indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通( 交通管制) 規例( 第374G 章) 延長 油麻地長度超 逾8 米及 12 米車輛 臨時 禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 3 月 31 日，以下路段將繼續全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 8 米及 12 米車輛臨時禁區 :- (i) 介乎炮台街及甘肅街之間的新填地街將全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 8 米車輛禁區 ; 及 (ii) 介乎上海街及炮台街之間的甘肅街將全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 12 米車輛禁區。 除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有長度超逾8米車輛的司機一律禁止將車輛駛入介乎炮台街及甘肅街之間的新填地街; 及所有長度超12米車輛的司機一律禁止將車輛駛入介乎上海街及炮台街之間的甘肅街。 有關地點已設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 374G) Corrigendum W ith reference to the Government Notice No. 249 in Gazette No. 2 of Vol. 2 9 published on 1 0 January 2025, it is hereby notified that "In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 6.01 am on 12 January 2025 to 6.00 am on 26 January 2025, the existing prohibited zone designated on the outer bus bay in Western Harbour Crossing (Hong Kong bound) T oll Plaza will be temporarily rescinded." should be amended as " In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 6.01 am on 12 January 2025 to 10.00 am on 24 January 2025, the existing prohibited zone designated on the outer bus bay in Western Harbour Crossing (Hong Kong bound) T oll Plaza will be temporarily rescinded." LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 條 例( 第374G 章) 勘誤 關於在2025年1月10日星期五第29卷第 2期憲報第249號公告中文版，現公布公告所載「本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年1月12日上午 6 時01分起，至2025年 1 月 26 日上午 6 時止，現時位於西區海底隧道(往香港方向)收費廣場外圍停車灣劃設的禁區，將暫予以撤銷。」應更正為「本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年1月12日上午 6 時01分起，至2025年 1 月 24 日上午 10 時止，現時位於西區海底隧道(往香港方向)收費廣場外圍停車灣劃設的禁區，將暫予以撤銷。」 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Restricted Zone on Ping Shun Street, Yuen Long In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 am on 7 February 2025 to 6.00 pm on 30 May 2025, the western kerbside lane of Ping Shun Street from a point about 20 metres north of its junction with Y uen Long On Ning Road to a point about 80 metres north of the same junction will be temporarily designated as a restricted zone 24 hours daily. Within the restricted zone, drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: (a) picking up or setting down passengers; or (b) loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zone will be indicated by appropriate road markings. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374G 章 ) 元朗屏信街臨時限制區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(b) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年 2 月7日上午 8 時起，至 2025 年 5 月 30 日晚上 6 時止，屏信街由其與元朗安寧路交界以北約 20 米處起，至同一交界以北約80米處止的西面路旁行車線，將暫劃為全日 24 小時限制區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： (a) 上落乘客；或 (b) 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Prohibited Zones For Vehicles Exceeding 11 Metres In Length On Lam Kam Road, Tai Po
title.tc: 大埔林錦公路長度超逾11米車輛禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374G) Prohibited Zones For Vehicles Exceeding 11 Metres In Length On Lam Kam Road, Tai Po In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 5.00 a.m. on 19 February 2025, Lam Kam Road will be designated as a prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 11 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles exceeding 11 metres in length, except buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into the road section of the above prohibited zone from Lam Kam Road interchange to the roundabout on Lam Kam Road near Ng Tung Chai 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles exceeding 11 metres in length, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into the road section of the above prohibited zone from the roundabout on Lam Kam Road near Sheung Tsuen to the roundabout on Lam Kam Road near Ng Tung Chai 24 hours daily. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zones at the abovementioned area will be rescinded. HO Kwong-hang, Patrick Commissioner for Transport (Acting)
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374G 章 ) 大埔 林錦公路長度超逾 11 米車 輛禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年2月19日上午5時起，林錦公路全日24小時劃為長度超逾11米車輛的禁區。 除巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有機動車輛的司機全日24小時一律禁止將長度超逾11米的車輛駛入上述禁區由林錦公路交匯處至林錦公路近梧桐寨迴旋處的路段。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有機動車輛的司機全日24小時一律禁止將長度超逾11米的車輛駛入上述禁區由林錦公路近上村迴旋處至林錦公路近梧桐寨迴旋處的路段。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，現時在上述範圍的禁區，將予以撤銷。 署理運輸署署長何廣鏗

Drivers of all motor vehicles except franchise buses, public light buses (scheduled services) and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the above prohibited zone. title.tc: 灣仔譚臣道長度超逾9米車輛臨時禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 9 Metres in Length on Thomson Road, Wan Chai In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 am on 21 March 2025 to 6.00 pm on 14 April 2025, the section of Thomson Road between Fenwick Street and Luard Road will be temporarily designated as a prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 9 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles, expect those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 9 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic sign. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通（交通管制）規例（第374G 章） 灣仔譚臣道長度超逾9 米車輛臨時禁區 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第374G章）第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年3月21日上午8時至2025年4月14日下午6時止，介乎分域街及盧押道的一段譚臣道將全日24小時暫劃為長度超逾9米車輛禁區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾9米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.tc: 洪水橋洪堤路限制區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) RESTRICTED ZONES ON HUNG TAI ROAD, HUNG SHUI KIU In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 a.m. on 21 March 2025, the following road sections will be designated as restricted zones 24 hours daily:– the northern kerbside lane of Hung Tai Road from its junction with the entrance/ exit of Coronet Court to a point about 25 metres west of the same junction; the northern kerbside lane of Hung Tai Road from its junction with the pedestrian crossing near the east of Coronet Court to a point about 85 metres west of the same junction; and the southern kerbside lane of Hung Tai Road from its junction with the pedestrian crossing near the east of Coronet Court to a point about 105 metres west of the same junction. Within the restricted zone, drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: picking up or setting down passengers; or loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zone will be indicated by appropriate road markings. At the same time, the existing restricted zones on the above road sections will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374G 章 ) 洪水橋洪堤路 限制區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章) 第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年3月21日上午10時起，以下路段將劃為全日24小時限制區： 洪堤路由其與通往錦珊園的出入口至同一交界以西約25米處止的北面路旁行車線； 洪堤路由其與近錦珊園東面的行人過路處交界處起至同一交界以西約85米處止的北面路旁行車線；及 洪堤路由其與近錦珊園東面的行人過路處交界處起至同一交界以西約105米處止的南面路旁行車線。 除專利巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： 上落乘客；或 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的限制區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) RESTRICTED ZONES ON PUI SHING ROAD, NGAN O ROAD, MING SHING STREET AND HANG HAU STATION PUBLIC TRANSPORT INTERCHANGE, TSEUNG KWAN O In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation (14)(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 11:00 a.m. on 28 March 2025, the following road sections in Tseung Kwan O will be designated as restricted zones 24 hours daily: (a) the northern kerbside lane of Ngan O Road from the junction of Ngan O Road and Pui Shing Road to a point about 25 meters east of the same junction; (b) the southern kerbside lane of Ngan O Road from the junction of Ngan O Road and Pui Shing Road to a point about 25 meters east of the same junction; (c) the western kerbside lane of Pui Shing Road from the junction of Pui Shing Road and the access road to Hang Hau Station Public Transport Interchange to the junction of Pui Shing Road and Ming Shing Street; (d) the southern kerbside lane of Ming Shing Street from the junction of Ming Shing Street and Pui Shing Road to the junction of Ming Shing Street and the access road to Hang Hau Station Public Transport Interchange; (e) the access road from Pui Shing Road to Hang Hau Station Public Transport Interchange; and (f) the northern kerbside lane of access road from Ming Shing Street to Hang Hau Station Public Transport Interchange. Within the restricted zones, drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from:- (a) picking up or setting down passengers; or (b) loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zones will be indicated by appropriate road markings. At the same time, the existing restricted zones on the above road sections will be rescinded. content.tc: 道路交通 (交通管制) 規例 (第374G章) 將軍澳培成路、銀澳路、名成街及坑口站公共運輸交匯處通道限制區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年3月28日上午11時起，將軍澳下列路段將全日24小時劃為限制區︰ (a) 由銀澳路與培成路交界處起，至同一交界以東約25米處止的銀澳路北面路旁行車線； (b) 由銀澳路與培成路交界處起，至同一交界以東約25米處止的銀澳路南面路旁行車線； (c) 由培成路與坑口站公共運輸交匯處通道交界處起，至培成路與名成街交界處止的培成路西面路旁行車線； (d) 由名成街與培成路交界處起，至名成街與坑口站公共運輸交匯處通道交界處止的名成街南面路旁行車線； (e) 由培成路進入坑口站公共運輸交匯處的通道；及 (f) 由名成街進入坑口站公共運輸交匯處的通道的北面路旁行車線。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內︰ (a) 上落乘客；或 (b) 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的限制區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Extension of Temporary Prohibited Zones for Vehicles Exceeding 8 Metres and 12 Metres in Length In Yau Ma Tei In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 1 April 2025 to 30 April 2025, the following road sections will continue to be temporarily designated as prohibited zones for vehicles exceeding 8 metres and 12 metres in length 24 hours daily:- (i) The section of Reclamation Street between Battery Street and Kansu Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length 24 hours daily; and (ii) The section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length 24 hours daily. content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) TEMPORARY PROHIBITED ZONE FOR VEHICLES EXCEEEDING 5 METRES IN LENGTH ON KADOORIE AVENUE, HO MAN TIN In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 9 May 2025 to 6.00 pm on 14 June 2025, the section of Kadoorie Avenue between Kadoorie Avenue house number 73A and 81A will be temporarily designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 5 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 5 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 何文田嘉道理道長度超逾5米車輛臨時禁區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年 5 月 9 日上午 10 時起至 2025 年 6 月 14 日下午 6 時止，嘉道理道介乎嘉道理道門牌 73A 號及 81A 號之間的路段，將全日 24 小時暫劃為長度超逾 5 米車輛禁區。 除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾 5 米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 5.5 Tonnes in Gross Weight in Lok Ma Chau, Yuen Long
title.tc: 元朗落馬洲總重量超逾5.5公噸車輛禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) PROHIBITED ZONE FOR VEHICLES EXCEEDING 5.5 TONNES IN GROSS WEIGHT IN LOK MA CHAU, YUEN LONG In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation (14)(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct with effect from 11:00 a.m. on 16 May 2025, the section of unnamed road between Lok Ma Chau Road and Ma Tso Lung Road will be designated as a prohibited zone for all motor vehicles exceeding 5.5 tonnes in gross weight 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 5.5 tonnes in gross weight into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zone on the above road section will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374G 章 ) 元朗落馬洲總重量超逾 5.5 公 噸車輛禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年5月16日上午11時起，介乎落馬洲路及馬草壟路的一段未命名道路，全日24小時劃為總重量超逾5.5公噸車輛的禁區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將總重量超逾5.5公噸的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的禁區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.en: RESTRICTED ZONES ON POK CHUEN STREET, SHA TIN
title.tc: 沙田博泉街限制區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374G) RESTRICTED ZONES ON POK CHUEN STREET, SHA TIN In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 23 May 2025, the following road sections will be designated as 5restricted zones 24 hours daily: (i) the western kerbside lane of Pok Chuen Street from a point about 210 metres north of its junction with the roundabout at the southern end of Pok Chuen Street to a point about 240 metres north of the same junction; (ii) the western kerbside lane of Pok Chuen Street from a point about 295 metres north of its junction with the roundabout at the southern end of Pok Chuen Street to a point about 330 metres north of the same junction; (iii) the eastern kerbside lane of Pok Chuen Street from a point about 235 metres north of its junction with the roundabout at the southern end of Pok Chuen Street to a point about 265 metres north of the same junction; and (iv) the eastern kerbside lane of Pok Chuen Street from a point about 310 metres north of its junction with the roundabout at the southern end of Pok Chuen Street to a point about 340 metres north of the same junction. Within the restricted zones, drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: (i) picking up or setting down passengers; or (ii) loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zones will be indicated by appropriate road markings. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 運輸署 道路交通 （ 交通管制 ） 規例 （ 第 374G 章 ) 沙田博泉街限制區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》（第374G章）第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年5月23日上午10時起，下列路段將劃為全日24小時限制區： (i) 博泉街由其與博泉街南面盡頭迴旋處以北約210米處起，至同一交界以北約240米處止的西面路旁行車線； (ii) 博泉街由其與博泉街南面盡頭迴旋處起以北約295米處起，至同一交界以北約330米處止的西面路旁行車線； (iii) 博泉街由其與博泉街南面盡頭迴旋處起以北約235米處起，至同一交界以北約265米處止的東面路旁行車線；及 (iv) 博泉街由其與博泉街南面盡頭迴旋處起以北約310米起，至同一交界以北約340米處止的東面路旁行車線。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： (i) 上落乘客；或 (ii) 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) EXTENSION OF TEMPORARY PROHIBITED ZONE FOR VEHICLES EXCEEDING 8 METRES IN LENGTH IN YAU CHEUNG ROAD, YAU MA TEI In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.00 midnight on 1 July 2025 to 11.59 pm on 30 September 2025, Yau Cheung Road will continue to be temporarily designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通( 交通管制) 規例( 第374G 章) 延長 油麻地 友翔道 長度超 逾8米車輛 臨時 禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 》( 第374G章 ) 第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年7月1日凌晨零時起，至2025 年9月30日晚上11時59分止，友翔道將繼續全日24小時暫劃為長度超逾8米車輛禁區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾 8 米車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點已設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩
