title.en: Prohibited Zone In Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port
title.tc: 港珠澳大橋香港口岸禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374) PROHIBITED ZONE IN HONG KONG-ZHUHAI-MACAO BRIDGE HONG KONG PORT In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(l)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.01 a.m. on 28 July 2025, the following sections of roads at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port will be designated as prohibited zones 24 hours daily as below:— Drivers of goods vehicles except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport will be prohibited from driving into Shun Fai Road from a point about 300 metres west of its junction with Chek Lap Kok Road to the same junction; Drivers of goods vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into the slip road from Shun Wui Road leading to Shun Fai Road; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except light goods vehicles and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into a section of Shun Ming Road westbound between a point about 40 metres north of its junction with Shun Fai Road and its junction with Shun Lin Road; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except New Territories Taxis, Fleet Taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into Shun Chit Road; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into a section of Shun Lui Road from its junction with Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Link Road to a point about 120 metres north of the same junction; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into a section of a unnamed slip road from a point 80 metres north of its junction with Shun Lui Road to the same junction; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except private cars, motorcycles and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into Car Park Nos. 1, 2 and 3; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except light goods vehicles and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into Car Park No. 4; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into Car Park No. 5; and Drivers of all motor vehicles, except Urban Taxis and Lantau Taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into the Urban Taxi and Lantau Taxi Queuing Area. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs on site. At the same time, the existing prohibited zones of the above sections as gazetted under G.N. 8037 on 19 October 2018 will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374 章 ) 港珠澳大橋香港口岸禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374章)第14(l)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年7月28日上午12時01分起，港珠澳大橋香港口岸下列路段全日24小時劃為禁區： 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將貨車駛入順暉路由其與赤鱲角路交界以西約300米起至同一交界處之間的路段； 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將貨車駛入順匯路往順暉路的支路； 除輕型貨車及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入順明路位於其與順暉路交界以北約40米起至其與順連路交界處之間的西行車道； 除新界的士及車隊的士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入順捷路； 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入順旅路由其港珠澳大橋香港連接路交界處起至同一交界處以北約120米之間的路段； 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入位於順旅路及未命名道路交界處至同一交界處以北約80米之間的未命名道路； 除私家車及電單車及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入1、2及3號停車場； 除輕型貨車及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入4號停車場； 除的士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入5號停車場；及 除市區的士及大嶼山的士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車司機一律禁止將車輛駛入市區的士及大嶼山的士等候區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，據2018年10月19日第8037號政府公告所公布，現時於上述路段實施的禁區將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長 李頌恩

title.en: Prohibited Zone In Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port Public Transport Interchange Pick-Up Area
title.tc: 港珠澳大橋香港口岸公共運輸交匯處上客區禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374) PROHIBITED ZONE IN HONG KONG-ZHUHAI-MACAO BRIDGE HONG KONG PORT PUBLIC TRANSPORT INTERCHANGE PICK-UP AREA In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(l)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.01 a.m. on 28 July 2025, the following sections of roads at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port Public Transport Interchange Pick-up Area will be designated as prohibited zones 24 hours daily:— (a) Drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the third cul-de-sac from the west end of this public transport interchange; (b) Drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses, public light buses (scheduled services) and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the fourth cul-de-sac from the west end of this public transport interchange; (c) Drivers of all motor vehicles, except buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the fifth cul-de-sac from the west end of this public transport interchange; (d) Drivers of all motor vehicles, except New Territories Taxis, Fleet Taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the sixth cul-de-sac from the west end of this public transport interchange; and (e) Drivers of all motor vehicles, except Urban Taxis and Lantau Taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the eastmost cul-de-sac of this public transport interchange. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs on site. At the same time, the existing prohibited zones of the above sections as gazetted under G.N. 3844 on 22 July 2022 will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374 章 ) 港珠澳大橋香港口岸公共運輸交匯處上客區禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374章)第14(l)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年7月28日上午12時01分起，位於港珠澳大橋香港口岸公共運輸交匯處上客區的下列路段全日24小時劃為禁區： (a) 除專利巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第三條盡頭路； (b) 除專利巴士、公共小巴(專線服務)及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第四條盡頭路； (c) 除巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第五條盡頭路； (d) 除新界的士及車隊的士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入由此公共運輸交匯處西面起計第六條盡頭路；及 (e) 除巿區的士及大嶼山的士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入此公共運輸交匯處最東面的盡頭路。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，據2022年7月22日第3844號政府公告所公布，現時於上述路段實施的禁區將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長 李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) EXTENSION OF TEMPORARY PROHIBITED ZONES FOR VEHICLES EXCEEDING 8 METRES AND 12 METRES IN LENGTH IN YAU MA TEI In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 1 August 2025 to 31 October 2025, the following road sections will continue to be temporarily designated as prohibited zones for vehicles exceeding 8 metres and 12 metres in length 24 hours daily:- The section of Reclamation Street between Battery Street and Kansu Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length 24 hours daily; and The section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street will be designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all vehicles, except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length into the section of Reclamation Street between Battery Street and Kansu Street; and vehicles exceeding 12 metres in length into the section of Kansu Street between Shanghai Street and Battery Street. The extent of the prohibited zone have been indicated by appropriate traffic signs. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通( 交通管制) 規例( 第374G 章) 延長 油麻地長度超 逾8 米及 12 米車輛 臨時 禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年 8 月 1 日至 2025 年 10 月 31 日，以下路段將繼續全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 8 米及 12 米車輛臨時禁區 :- 介乎炮台街及甘肅街之間的新填地街將全日 24 小時劃為長度超逾 8 米車輛禁區 ; 及 介乎上海街及炮台街之間的甘肅街將全日24小時劃為長度超逾12米車輛禁區。 除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有長度超逾 8 米車輛的司機一律禁止將車輛駛入介乎炮台街及甘肅街之間的新填地街 ; 及所有長度超 12 米車輛的司機一律禁止將車輛駛入介乎上海街及炮台街之間的甘肅街。 有關地點已設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長李頌恩

title.tc: 延長火炭㘭背灣街與達業里臨時限制區

content.en: TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (Chapter 374G) EXTENSION OF TEMPORARY RESTRICTED ZONES ON AU PUI WAN STREET AND TAT YIP LANE, FO TAN In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 31 July 2025 to 15 September 2025, the following road sections will continue to be designated as restricted zone 24 hours daily:- (a) The section of Au Pui Wan Street between Kwei Tei Street and Tat Yip Lane; and (b) The section of Tat Yip Lane from its junction with Au Pui Wan Street to a point about 85 metres west of the same junction. Within the restricted zones, drivers of all motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: (a) picking up or setting down passengers; or (b) loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs and road markings. At the same time, the existing restricted zone on the above sections will be temporarily rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela, Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 運輸署 道路交通 (交通管制) 規例（第374G章） 延長火炭㘭背灣街與達業里臨時限制區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(b) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2025 年 7 月 31 日起至 2025 年 9 月 15 日止，下列路段繼續劃為全日 24 小時限制區： (a) 㘭背灣街介乎桂地街及達業里之間的路段；及 (b) 達業里由其與㘭背灣街交界處起，至其同一交界以西約85米處止的路段。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： (a) 上落乘客；或 (b) 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌及道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的限制區，將暫予撒銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) PROHIBITED ZONES IN HONG KONG PORT AREA OF SHENZHEN BAY PORT In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 12.01 a.m. on 28 July 2025, the following area and road sections in Hong Kong Port Area of Shenzhen Bay Port will be designated prohibited zones 24 hours daily: Drivers of all motor vehicles, except buses, fleet taxis and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the coach pick-up area; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except private cars and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the northbound access road leading to the departure private car holding area starting from its diverging point with the northbound access road leading to the coach drop-off area; Drivers of all motor vehicles, except buses, goods vehicles and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the northbound access road leading to the coach drop-off area starting from its diverging point with the northbound access road leading to the departure private car holding area; and Drivers of all motor vehicles, except buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving any vehicles into the northbound access road north of the coach drop-off area leading to the departure coach examination kiosks. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs on site. At the same time, the existing prohibited zones implemented in the Hong Kong Port Area of Shenzhen Bay Port as gazetted in G.N. 4165 of 2007 will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通（交通管制）規例（第 374G 章） 深圳灣口岸 港方口岸區禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2025年7月28日上午12時01分起，深圳灣口岸港方口岸區下列地區及路段全日24小時劃為禁區： 除巴士、車隊的士司機及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止駕駛任何車輛進入旅遊巴士上客區； 除私家車司機及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止駕駛任何車輛進入與通往旅遊巴士落客區的北行通路的分岔點起，至通往離境私家車輪候區的北行通路； 除巴士、貨車司機及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止駕駛任何車輛進入與通往離境私家車輪候區的北行通路的分岔點起，至通往旅遊巴士落客區的北行通路；及 除巴士司機及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止駕駛任何車輛進入旅遊巴士落客區以北通往離境旅遊巴士檢查亭的北行通路。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，據2007年第4165號政府公告所公布，現時在深圳灣口岸港方口岸區實施的禁區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長李頌恩

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) PROHIBITED ZONE FOR VEHICLES EXCEEDING 3 TONNES IN GROSS WEIGHT ON TAI TAM ROAD, SOUTHERN DISTRICT In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 7.00 am on 27 February 2026, the section of Tai Tam Road southbound from its junction with Shek O Road to its junction with Tai Tam Reservoir Road will be designated as prohibited zone for all motor vehicles exceeding 3 tonnes in gross weight from 7.00 a.m. to 10.00 a.m. and from 3.00 p.m. to 7.00 p.m. daily. Drivers of motor vehicles, except buses, light buses, taxis, private cars and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 3 tonnes in gross weight into the above prohibited zones. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zone on the above road section will be rescinded. LEE Chung-yan, Angela Commissioner for Transport

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) PROHIBITED ZONES IN MA WAN, TSUEN WAN In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 9.00 am on 30 April 2026, all roads in Ma Wan will be designated as prohibited zones 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the prohibited zones 24 hours daily except:- goods vehicles from 10.00 am to 4.00 pm daily; urban taxis for access to/from Ma Wan Road, the roundabout between Ma Wan Road and Pak Lam Road, Pak Lam Road south of Fong Yuen Road, Fong Yuen Road and Ma Wan Rural Committee Road 24 hours daily; and to/from Pak Yan Road and the section of Pak Lai Road between Pak Lam Road and Pak Yan Road from 9.00 am to 11.00 pm daily; buses from 9.00 am to 11.00 pm daily for access to/from Ma Wan Road, the roundabout between Ma Wan Road and Pak Lam Road, Pak Lam Road south of Fong Yuen Road, Fong Yuen Road, Pak Yan Road and the section of Pak Lai Road between Pak Lam Road and Pak Yan Road; and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport. The extent of the prohibited zones will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. At the same time, the existing prohibited zones in Ma Wan, Tsuen Wan as gazetted in G.N. 7756 of 2021 will be rescinded. Miss TSE Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 荃灣馬灣禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2026年4月30日上午9時起，馬灣所有道路全日24小時劃為禁區。 除： 貨車(只限每日上午10時至下午4時)； 市區的士全日24小時往來馬灣路、馬灣路與珀林路之間的迴旋處、芳園路以南的一段珀林路、芳園路和馬灣鄉事會路，及每日上午9時至晚上11時往來珀欣路和介乎珀林路與珀欣路之間的一段珀麗路； 巴士每日上午9時至晚上11時往來馬灣路、馬灣路與珀林路之間的迴旋處、芳園路以南的一段珀林路、芳園路、珀欣路和介乎珀林路與珀欣路之間的一段珀麗路；及 經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外。 機動車輛司機全日24小時一律禁止駕駛車輛進入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 同時，據2021年第7756號政府公告所公布，現時在荃灣馬灣實施的禁區，將予以撤銷。 運輸署署長謝詠誼

Schedule Tse Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport

title.en: Extension Of Temporary Prohibited Zone In Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange
title.tc: 延長觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處臨時禁區的實施期限

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) EXTENSION OF TEMPORARY PROHIBITED ZONE IN KWUN TONG FERRY PIER PUBLIC TRANSPORT INTERCHANGE In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 0.00 am on 28 June 2026 to 11.59 pm on 31 August 2026, Kwun Tong Ferry Pier Public Transport Interchange will continue to be temporarily designated as a prohibited zone 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles except franchise buses, public light buses (scheduled services) and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport will be prohibited from driving vehicles into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone has been indicated by appropriate traffic signs. TSE Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通（交通管制）規例（第374G章） 延長觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處臨時禁區的實施期限 本人現行使《道路交通（交通管制）規例》（第374G章）第14（1）（a）條所賦予的權力，下令由2026年6月28日凌晨零時零分起至2026年8月31日下午11時59分止，觀塘碼頭公共運輸交匯處繼續全日24小時暫劃為禁區。 除專利巴士、專線小巴及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長謝詠誼

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zone For Vehicles Exceeding 5 Metres In Length On Kadoorie Avenue, Ho Man Tin
title.tc: 何文田嘉道理道長度超逾5米車輛臨時禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) TEMPORARY PROHIBITED ZONE FOR VEHICLES EXCEEDING 5 METRES IN LENGTH ON KADOORIE AVENUE, HO MAN TIN In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 10.00 am on 3 July 2026 to 6.00 pm on 25 January 2027, the section of Kadoorie Avenue between Kadoorie Avenue house number 73A and 81A will be temporarily designated as prohibited zone for vehicles exceeding 5 metres in length 24 hours daily. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except for access and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 5 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. TSE Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 何文田嘉道理道長度超逾5米車輛臨時禁區 本人現行使《道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 》 ( 第 374G 章 ) 第 14(1)(a) 條所賦予的權力，下令由 2026 年 7 月 3 日上午 10 時至 2027 年 1 月 25 日下午 6 時，嘉道理道介乎嘉道理道門牌 73A 號及 81A 號之間的路段，將全日 24 小時暫劃為長度超逾 5 米車輛禁區。 除前往此區者及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾 5 米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長謝詠誼

title.en: Temporary Restricted Zone on Lei Muk Road, Kwai Chung
title.tc: 葵涌梨木道臨時限制區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Restricted Zone on Lei Muk Road, Kwai Chung In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(b) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 8.00 am on 6 July 2026 to 6.00 pm on 31 August 2026, the eastern kerbside lane of the layby on Lei Muk Road southbound from a point about 38 metres north of its junction with Tung Chi Street to a point about 97 metres north of the same junction will be temporarily designated as restricted zone 24 hours daily. Within the restricted zones, drivers of all motor vehicles, except franchised buses and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from: picking up or setting down passengers; or loading or unloading goods. The extent of the restricted zones will be indicated by appropriate road markings. At the same time, the existing restricted zone on the above road section will be temporarily rescinded. TSE Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例（第 374G 章 ) 葵涌梨木道臨時 限制區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章) 第14(1)(b)條所賦予的權力，下令由2026年7月6日上午8時起，至2026年8月31日下午6時止，梨木道(南行)由其與童子街交界處以北約38米處起，至同一交界以北約97米處止的東面路旁行車線的停車灣，將全日24小時暫劃為限制區。 除專利巴士及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，所有機動車輛司機一律禁止在限制區內： 上落乘客；或 起卸貨物。 有關地點將設置適當道路標記，表明限制區範圍。 同時，現時在上述路段實施的限制區，將暫予撤銷。 運輸署署長謝詠誼

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length near Kam Ping Street, North Point
title.tc: 北角近錦屏街臨時長度超逾8米車輛禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) TEMPORARY PROHIBITED ZONE FOR VEHICLES EXCEEDING 8 METRES IN LENGTH NEAR KAM PING STREET, NORTH POINT In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 9.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m. daily on 12 July 2026 and 19 July 2026, the unnamed access road north of Kam Ping Street between Hung Fuk Building and Fortuna Building will be temporarily designated as a prohibited zone for all motor vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except those driving vehicles of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and those with permits issued by the Commissioner of Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 8 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. TSE Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通 (交通管制) 規例 (第374G章) 北角近錦屏街臨時長度超逾8米車輛禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令2026年7月12日及2026年7月19日每日由上午9時起至下午5時止，錦屏街以北介乎鴻福大樓及幸福大樓之間的未命名通路將臨時劃為長度超逾8米車輛禁區。 除駕駛食物環境衛生署車輛及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾8米車輛的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長謝詠誼

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zone at Kwai Hing Station Public Transport Interchange, Kwai Chung
title.tc: 葵涌葵興站公共運輸交匯處臨時禁區

content.en: GAZETTE NOTICE ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) Temporary Prohibited Zone at Kwai Hing Station Public Transport Interchange, Kwai Chung In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 0.01 am to 5.30 am on 11 July 2026, the leftmost and second leftmost lanes of the unnamed access road from Hing Fong Road northbound leading to Kwai Hing Station Public Transport Interchange will be temporarily designated as a prohibited zone. Drivers of all motor vehicles, except taxis, public light buses (scheduled services) and those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving into the above prohibited zone. The exact boundary of the prohibited zone is delineated by hatching on the drawing shown in the Schedule. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. SCHEDULE TSE Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 運輸署 道路交通 ( 交通管制 ) 規例 ( 第 374 章，附屬法例 G) 葵涌葵興站公共運輸交匯處臨時禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374章，附屬法例 G)第14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令於2026年7月11日由凌晨零時01分起至上午5時30分止，由興芳路北行通往葵興站公共運輸交匯處的未命名通路的最左邊及最左邊第二條行車線暫劃為禁區。 除的士、公共小巴(專線服務)及經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將車輛駛入上述禁區。禁區的確實範圍，已在附表的圖則以影線示明。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 附 表 運輸署署長謝詠誼

title.en: Temporary Prohibited Zone for Vehicles Exceeding 7 Metres in Length at Cochrane Street, Central
title.tc: 中環閣麟街長度超逾7米車輛臨時禁區

content.en: ROAD TRAFFIC (TRAFFIC CONTROL) REGULATIONS (CHAPTER 374G) TEMPORARY PROHIBITED ZONE FOR VEHICLES EXCEEDING 7 METRES IN LENGTH AT COCHRANE STREET, CENTRAL In exercise of the powers vested in me under regulation 14(1)(a) of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations, Chapter 374G, I hereby direct that with effect from 9.00 pm to 6.00 am of the following day daily on Mondays to Thursdays between 20 July 2026 and 30 July 2026, the section of Cochrane Street between Stanley Street and Wellington Street will be temporarily designated as a prohibited zone for all motor vehicles exceeding 7 metres in length. Drivers of motor vehicles, except those with permits issued by the Commissioner for Transport, will be prohibited from driving vehicles exceeding 7 metres in length into the above prohibited zone. The extent of the prohibited zone will be indicated by appropriate traffic signs. TSE Wing-yee, Winnie Commissioner for Transport
content.tc: 道路交通(交通管制)規例(第374G章) 中環閣麟街長度超逾7米車輛臨時禁區 本人現行使《道路交通(交通管制)規例》(第374G章)第 14(1)(a)條所賦予的權力，下令由2026年7月20日至2026年7月30日期間，逢星期一至星期四每日下午9時起至翌日上午6時止，閣麟街介乎士丹利街與威靈頓之間的路段，暫劃為長度超逾7米車輛的禁區。 除經由運輸署署長發給許可證者外，機動車輛司機一律禁止將長度超逾7米的車輛駛入上述禁區。 有關地點將設置適當交通標誌，表明禁區範圍。 運輸署署長謝詠誼
